Lendiq explained
In most DeFi lending, you borrow only if you lock up extra money as collateral. The protocol doesn’t care if you’re good at judging risk.
Lendiq adds another way to prove you’re trustworthy: you bet on real outcomes in prediction markets. If you’re often right, you build an on-chain score.
A better score means you can borrow more, pay less interest, and put up less collateral.
So the idea is: being good at forecasting becomes part of your credit
